model: BiLSTM gesture-sequence encoder (CosFace), HMOG continuous authentication
selected: seed 2 = best mean valid EER (N10, N20) of 3 seeds
checkpoint_contents: state_dict, args, features, std_mean/std_std (train-user standardisation), user split
recommended_use: Combine with the window-stats LDA score (models.biometrics.metrics.fuse); see reports/biometrics_hmog.md. Alone it is weaker than LDA. Output = similarity to the user's enrolled profile; 1 - similarity is the behavioural-deviation signal for fusion.
limitations: HMOG has no coercion labels (signal = deviation from own baseline, not coercion); touch pressure is constant on the HMOG phone; 15 test users, so +/- ~1pt differences are noise.
